# skills.sh

> > skills.sh is a platform for sharing and discovering reusable AI agent skills, Copilot extensions, and MCP tools for GitHub Copilot, Azure, and other AI development workflows.

The site hosts a community-driven repository of skills that enhance AI coding assistants with specialized capabilities ranging from API development and cloud migration to testing frameworks and design systems. Skills are packaged as SKILL.md files that provide structured context for AI agents.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- AI agents and agentic development
- Azure cloud services
- Context management
- Copilot skills and extensions
- CLI tools and automation
- API documentation and routes
- Design tokens and accessibility
- Best practices and coding standards
- Server-side development
- Testing frameworks
- Cloud migration
- SKILL.md format

## GitHub Copilot & MCP Tools

- [github-copilot-starter](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/github-copilot-starter): GitHub Copilot project starter with configuration and coding standards
- [mcp-cli](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/mcp-cli): MCP CLI reference for server discovery and JSON schema tool integration
- [ruby-mcp-server-generator](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/ruby-mcp-server-generator): Ruby MCP server generator for scaffolding projects with Ruby SDK
- [agentic-development-principles](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/agentic-development-principles): AI agent development principles for context management and workflows
- [remembering-conversations](https://skills.sh/obra/episodic-memory/remembering-conversations): Episodic memory skill for AI agent conversation search and context mgmt

## Azure Cloud Development

- [azure-compliance](https://skills.sh/microsoft/github-copilot-for-azure/azure-compliance): Azure compliance skill using azqr for security auditing and assessment
- [azure-cloud-migrate](https://skills.sh/microsoft/github-copilot-for-azure/azure-cloud-migrate): Azure cloud migration skill for AWS Lambda to Azure Functions conversion

## Web Development & API Skills

- [expo-api-routes](https://skills.sh/expo/skills/expo-api-routes): Expo API routes skill for server-side endpoints and HTTP request handling
- [create-web-form](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/create-web-form): Web form creation skill with HTML/CSS/JS validation and accessibility
- [api-documentation](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/api-documentation): OpenAPI/Swagger REST API documentation template for user management
- [tailwind-design-system](https://skills.sh/wshobson/agents/tailwind-design-system): Tailwind CSS v4 design system with tokens, theming, and dark mode
- [polish](https://skills.sh/pbakaus/impeccable/polish): UI polish skill for visual refinement, typography, and accessibility

## Testing & DevOps

- [csharp-tunit](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/csharp-tunit): C# TUnit testing framework skill with data-driven test best practices
- [containerize-aspnet-framework](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/containerize-aspnet-framework): ASP.NET Framework containerization skill for Docker Windows with IIS
- [winapp-cli](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/winapp-cli): Windows App CLI reference for MSIX packaging and certificate management

## Documentation & Planning

- [create-technical-spike](https://skills.sh/github/awesome-copilot/create-technical-spike): Technical spike documentation template for time-boxed research planning
- [baoyu-format-markdown](https://skills.sh/jimliu/baoyu-skills/baoyu-format-markdown): Markdown formatter skill for CJK text processing and CLI configuration

## Marketing & Growth

- [page-cro](https://skills.sh/coreyhaines31/marketingskills/page-cro): Conversion rate optimization skill for landing pages and CTAs
- [referral-program](https://skills.sh/coreyhaines31/marketingskills/referral-program): Referral program design skill for viral growth and incentive strategy
- [bmad-idea](https://skills.sh/supercent-io/skills-template/bmad-idea): BMAD creative intelligence suite for brainstorming and design thinking
